---
name: Contribution offer
about: You have material or memory from an e-fed — an archive, a drive, a correction, or just what you remember.
title: "Contribution: "
labels: contribution
---

**What fed(s)?** (names, years if you remember, any URLs)

**What do you have?** (files, links, screenshots, memories — no need to
organize anything)

**Were you part of it?** (player, owner, reader — helps with consent
and crediting; how you're credited is your call, including not at all)

**Anything that should stay sealed?** (material you're sharing for the
record but that shouldn't be displayed)
